ankleSetup: Komotil kelyek ko mi tait. Tuiy sostonik tait, as itiri kogeny.
aquaticSetup: Eng' beek che matin ak toretet, bandote anan tikse mos.
aquaticSub: Wendi anan tibei peek che tinyei.
armLibraryCopy: Ng'alechu bo koinet eut komie ak koit shoulder height.
armSetup: Itegisto borto ne barak kong'ere. Koine lakwet eut kobwan balloon zone.
balanceGameSub: Tonon koik ketit si iyoru ringinikab balance.
balanceLibraryCopy: Ng'alechu bo koet balance komie kotoreto.
balanceSetup: Nyolu keit bek kanta. Lakwet ko tononi ketit, sireti siling' ak chito ne ribei.
ball-throwSetup: Bet eng' therapy ball ak toretet. Tuch ak tach ball ne miando.
ballThrowSetup: Pir therapy ball kotoretin. Boku ak inam mpira ne melil.
beadsSetup: Am string ne tolo, ak itui beads che echen' agenge agenge.
bilatSetup: Toret kogasgei eun aeng' kotugul — kobas eun, komut, anan korol mpira.
bodyMoving: Kikibagach movement ne oo nebo borto
breathingSetup: Bai anan bet komie. Tai eung' eng' moet ak iywek mos.
breathingSub: Iywek mos ak lo eng' eung' eng' moet.
bridgeSetup: Kergei eng' let, kutikab kelyek ko kuwen. Ting' kipseng'wek mos si iyai bridge.
brushSetup: Boisien brush ne miando. Brush eunek ak keldai mos kou kiimwojin therapist.
buttonsSetup: Boisien dressing board ne mi buttons che echen'. Somane keib ak keyong'.
catchSetup: Tupchu mpiret ne moror mutyo eng' tororet ne bo kabet. Ome lakwet ak euwek tuwai.
clapSetup: Kerer camera. Kap eng' taitab kabet kila kalilen taitaiyet.
crawlSetup: Tilil ole kimunotin. Toret lakwet komosge akwendi ole mi galalyet ne cham.
cutSetup: Am safety scissors ak toretet. Til subu line ne toror ak ne tolo.
dailyPlanCopy: Yai session agenge bo eut, agenge bo keldet, ak agenge bo balance kotoret siretab lakwet.
drawSetup: Boisien crayon eng' karatasi, anan tuiyo umbot eng' koristo ak sormet.
dressSetup: Boisien practice board ne tinye buttons ak zips che oo.
feedSetup: Konor bead ne mining eng' spoon. Iste lakwet matenyoru.
gaitLibraryCopy: Ng'alechu bo wet komi tororet ak training ne bo steps.
gaitSetup: Los orit ne mie. Tebe mos tait ak ketoret.
gripSetup: Boisien sponge ne moror anan stress ball. Nyech, ket 3 sekondis, ang' koyiach.
guidedSetup: Igo kererei lakwet eng' kamera, ak isubi ng'alekab toretetab simet.
half-kneelSetup: Tai mut agenge ng'weny ak tai keldai age taitou komitei komos. Tebi ak toretet.
halfKneelSetup: Koo kutit agenge ng'ony ak koo keldet age kotonon talam tai. Mut kotoretin.
halfKneelSub: Kutit agenge ng'ony, ak keldet age ne tai.
handwritingSetup: Boisien morit anan crayon si isore lines, circles ak crosses.
headSetup: Toret lakwet komotil. Baanchi mos kityet ne lolchin si kotebi ak konyek.
headSub: Tebi lakwet ne bandi ak konyekuk.
heel-raiseSetup: Am rail. Mitei eng' soksekab keldai, tebi, kosir ibit mos.
heelRaiseSetup: Mut railit. Teegei koboru pirik, mut, ako iwegei mutyo.
heelRaiseSub: Teegei barak koboru pirik ak iwegei ng'ony.
horseSetup: Bet eng' bolster neo anan peanut ball kou iiro tany. Tebi komnyei kot kimuchke mos.
horseSub: Bet eng' bolster kou iiro tany ak ing'alal.
kneelingSetup: Pirpir matit ne melil, koroochon kutik ak beek. Mut kotoretin.
kneelingSub: Pirpir kotonon barak ak imut kotoretin.
langFallbackNote: Mi UI eng English kot kochobchin tafsiri che {lang}.
legLibraryCopy: PT instruction: Tonon eng keldet ne nyalul, matin rail, kek anan kwerchi keldet age. Siretab lakwet kotoret kokile eng koret ye imuche.
legSetup: Tonon koik kelyet ne nyalul, imuchchin reling. Tuiy lakwek ak kelyet age.
marchSetup: Imuch taburet eng' ketoret. Ting' kutikab kelyek kou usengechuk, anyoru ng'alyotab ngoma.
midlineSetup: Konor taitaiwek eng' upande age ne bo borto. Tane lakwet eun kesia midline.
obstacleSetup: Koo tuguk che mining' ak che melilik eng' lainit. Kwanan barakab tugul kotoretin.
oralSetup: Boisien straw anan bubble wand. Uso mos si kiimyei misingekab kut.
oralSub: Uso bubbles anan icham eng' straw.
pinchSetup: Konor beads/pom-poms eng' tray. Nyipe lakwet ak sormet ne oo ak sormet age.
pinchSub: Nyip beads che mengechen kome cup.
playdoughSetup: Boisien play dough ne miando. Biring', nyit ak mat ak eunek aeng'.
pnfSetup: Nyori eun ng'ony kosir bortit, kosir itee barak ak sang.
proneSetup: Irogei cheptulel. Nyori kokwet ak itee met ak bortit ne bo tai.
proneSub: Teei met ak bortit ne bo tai koirokei cheptulel.
puzzleSetup: Tui shape ak igo eng' oret ne imachchin.
reachSetup: Kech toy ne moror eng shoulder height. Korechin lakwet toy.
rollingSetup: Irogei matit. Rolagei mutyo kong'eti ng'onyit konam cheptulel ak iwek.
rollingSub: Rolagei kong'eti ng'onyit konam cheptulel ak kowek.
safetyNote: Istaap ye mi pain, dizziness, anan fatigue ne magan.
sensorySetup: Tayaris textures somok (ne moror, ne ngarng'ar ak ne tinye tuituiwek). Taio lakwet kila age.
sensorySub: Taiya che moror, che kimnye ak che tinye tuituiwek.
shoulderSetup: Komotil akoi tonon komie. Kernei kotunwek kobun tait, barak, let, ak ng'weny.
shoulderSub: Kernei sirkelinik echen koik kobun barak.
sidelyingSetup: Irogei barak kotoret. Kiiwei ak toyit koboru eun aeng'.
sidelyingSub: Kiiwei ak eun aeng' koirogei barak.
simonSetup: Mwoe toretindet yawek. Tuiye lakwet ago mwa Simon kende.
sitstandSetup: Komotil taburet ne kimen, kelyek ko mi ng'weny. Tonon mos, as komotil kogeny.
squatSetup: Konor kelyek kou tebesyatab kotunwek, imuch reling, kuw kutikab kelyek matin, as koiton.
step-upSetup: Boisien step ne ng'ering' ak rail. Istepe eut agenge, kosir en age.
stepUpSetup: Kwanan ak stepit ne mining' ne mi railit. Kwanan barak ak keldet agenge, kosir age.
stepUpSub: Kwanei barak ak ng'ony eng' blockit ne mining'.
stretchSetup: Toret keng'er mos musclinik che kimen. Itnen kila stretch sekondinik 15–20.
trackSetup: Ket metit matinyor. Rup ket ne weete mutyo ak konyek kende.
trunkSetup: Komotil komie. Kernei kanta ne mi barak mos, kairir ak kaina.
trunkSub: Kernei kanta si inam taretyet ne banani.
wall-standSetup: Tonon komuti kot ak keeloch koekutukut ak sein. Tebi ak toretet.
wallStandSetup: Tonon sumbeit ak keldoonik kogilgei mokoryot. Mut kotoretin.
